title: Width bound on the left block of a merged array
statement: Let $g_1$ and $g_2$ be families of DNF formulas over $n$ variables, indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}\,m_1$ and $\mathrm{Fin}\,m_2$ respectively, and let $\ell$ be a natural number. Suppose every formula $g_1(k)$ has width at most $\ell$. Form the merged array of length $m_1+m_2$, which reproduces $g_1$ on the first $m_1$ indices and $g_2$ on the remaining ones. Then for each $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,m_1$, the entry of the merged array at the position of $i$ inside the first block again has width at most $\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: g₁, g₂ are families of DNF formulas over n variables indexed by Fin m₁ and Fin m₂
i is an index in Fin m₁, embedded into the first block
replaced:
If every $g_1\,k$ has width at most $l$, then for each $i : \mathrm{Fin}\,m_1$ the merged
gate at the left-embedded index satisfies
$(\mathrm{mergeGates}\,g_1\,g_2\,(\mathrm{castAdd}\,m_2\,i)).\mathrm{width} \le l$.
